headings: (125 G) SALTY BUTTER CROISSANT SCENTED CANDLE

jsonld_raw.name: (125 G) SALTY BUTTER CROISSANT SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax.

Salty Butter Croissant | In the morning breeze, the perfume of the still-warm croissant intertwines with the spicy caress of cardamom and the smoothness of hazelnut. Salted butter glides its golden sheen over cereals and praline, while vanilla and amber beat like the memory of a still-warm table.

Notes:
Top notes: croissant, cardamom, hazelnut, salted butter.
Heart notes: cereals, bread, praline.
Base notes: vanilla, amber.
